name.zh: 数值调节：部署人数与资金

description.zh: 把部署人数上限、每回合发的资金（含初始资金）改成 knobs.json 里写的数值。只改数字，不加干员、不加规则，对局标记为非官方。
description.en: Sets the deploy cap and the per-round income (including the first round) to the numbers in knobs.json. Numbers only: no new operators, no new rules; matches are marked unofficial.
